description: This file declares functions related to MMC card operations, including initialization, SD card status checking, logging, and reading log file content.

methods.name: isSdCardAlive
methods.description: Checks if the SD card is currently accessible.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a line to the log stored on the MMC card.

methods.name: readLogFileContent
methods.description: Reads content from the log file into a buffer.
